verdicts.reason: A puts the SOLSTICE wordmark below the headline, which breaks the reading order. Its flavour pills are shrunk to illegible micro-text and their order is reversed. All the content is crammed into the right two-thirds, leaving the left side empty apart from the circle, and the CTA and subhead crowd the peach circle. B keeps the original order and has legible pills, but the headline sits about 12px left of the wordmark and subhead, and it runs almost to the right edge. The CTA floats off to the right, disconnected from the left-aligned column, and a large dead band remains under the pills.
